**engram.pull.test.mjs stops reindexing the real .memory/index.jsonl (#1026)**

pullMemory()'s production repoRoot default (engram.mjs:538-541) was reached by two tests in engram.pull.test.mjs that omitted root/_rebuildIndex, mutating the real .memory/index.jsonl on every full-suite run and breaking cold-review candidates. Root cause: the file's own header comment claimed this was deliberate and pre-existing, unverified — measured that only tests (a) and (e) actually reached the real root; (c) did not, because _gitPull throws before the _rebuildIndex step runs. Fix: inject root+_rebuildIndex into all three tests, add a before/after content+mtime guard (content alone is insufficient — rebuildIndex's deterministic regen can reproduce byte-identical output even after a real write). Extended test-hygiene.test.mjs with a second guard rule (findMissingRootViolations) covering all 9 of engram.mjs's root-defaulting exports, import-alias aware, with comment/string-literal blanking to avoid false positives on prose mentions of the function names.
